Hot Tub Pad

A filled hot tub weighs roughly 2,000 to 8,000 pounds, so it needs a solid, level base. Master Spas, Caldera and Bullfrog all name a reinforced concrete slab at least 4 inches thick as the standard, and Caldera specifies one that supports at least 120 pounds per square foot. Compacted pavers or a gravel base can work for many tubs; a deck needs a structural engineer or contractor. Never set a tub on grass.

Swipe for the details. The full guide, with every source linked, is at the link in bio.
